description: GTFS | Transportes Urbanos de Braga is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Transportes Urbanos de Braga, Empresa Municipal. Data in GTFS format of the public offer of Braga Urban Transport. These data are currently implemented in Google Transit, Apple Maps, Moovit, Open Street Maps and numerous other platforms that use the GTFS standard. Coverage: Transportes Urbanos de Braga, Empresa Municipal. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS | Urban Transport of Braga" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Transportes Urbanos de Braga, Empresa Municipal. Its keywords include transportes-publicos, braga, gtfs, urbanos, transportes-aereos. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
